description.narrative: SDG 13 Climate ActionFor more information about the GE RF methodological notes please check https://europa.eu/capacity4dev/eurfi

comment.narrative: Indicator was measured based on the indicator statement of kg of CO2 saved thanks to the replacement of kerosene lanterns by photovoltaic panels or other renewable energy sources

The value was changed from 200900 to 237.5 during Quality Control. Additionally the match to the same indicator was removed as it was unnecessary and creating double counting issues for the Results Dashboard. 1. This is an EURF indicator and the methodology note requires reporting the expected result i.e. the target as the current value 237500 kg. 2. The units of the values provided in the report are kg but the EURF value must be reported using tonnes. The final target must also be revised to 237.5 tonnes. If this is not done this will have a negative effect on the score for EAMR KPI 10
